chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from whom he mentioned, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Nawfali, from Ibrahim ibn Isa, from his father, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)

That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) circumambulated the Kaaba, and when he reached the Yemeni Corner, he raised his head toward the Kaaba and then said: 'All praise is to Allah who honored you and magnified you, and all praise is to Allah who sent me as a Prophet and made Ali an Imam. O Allah, guide him to the best of Your creation and keep him away from the worst of Your creation.'
And it is recommended to embrace the Kaaba from its rear opposite the door.

key_terms.الرُّكْنُ الْيَمَانِيُّ: The Yemeni Corner of the Kaaba
key_terms.الِالْتِزَامُ: Embracing the Kaaba, a recommended ritual act

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication recited by the Prophet at the Yemeni Corner during Tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Prophet’s specific supplication at the Yemeni Corner, explicitly linking the sanctity of the Kaaba with the divine appointment of Imam Ali, a key theme in Shia theology regarding the continuity of prophetic authority. It further establishes the recommended practice of *Iltizam* (pressing the chest and cheeks against the Kaaba opposite the door), which is derived from the Prophet’s own actions and serves as a physical manifestation of devotion and seeking closeness to God.
